title: Juicy Chinese Rice Bowl
description: A creamy, spicy rice bowl packed with kimchi, tofu and a tangy lime finish, perfect for a post-workout meal.
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté minced ginger until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add cubed tofu to the skillet and stir‑fry until lightly browned on all sides, about 3 minutes.
Stir in drained kimchi and continue cooking for another 2 minutes to blend flavors.
Pour in soy sauce and stir until the sauce coats the tofu and kimchi evenly.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, tossing everything together until heated through, about 2 minutes.
Remove the skillet from heat and fold in softened cream cheese until it melts into a creamy sauce.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the bowl and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl, top with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onions.
Serve immediately while hot, allowing the creamy texture to mingle with the spicy kimchi.
